checks.summary: The mounted production editor reuses the tracked controlled snapshot and incremental ChangeSet for normal input, with a full-document fallback only when the tracked start state is unavailable. Updates enter the shared document owner; controlled echoes, stale owners and rejected transactions cannot replace newer input. The same owner preserves selection, undo, save writeback and recovery, while LSP synchronization is conditional and debounced. The performance observer is passive and cannot inject state or drive input.
